doc: Ask provider presets (docs/plans/ask-tab.md §Provider presets). One OpenAI-compatible client; each preset has its own key in the OS credential store under its id. `keys_url` is where the user gets or replaces a key (shown with key errors); `session_header` sends x-opencode-session per chat (OpenCode Go refuses requests without it, NOTEBOOK 2026-11-14 11:28). `custom` takes any base URL, including a local Ollama / LM Studio / llama-server, and may need no key. `device` runs the model on the phone's GPU through LiteRT-LM (rust/decklight-server/src/ask/ondevice.rs); its models are downloaded under On this device, not fetched from a URL.

presets.name: OpenCode Go
presets.note: Subscription: monthly allowance per model, 20% per 5 h, 50% per week.

presets.name: OpenCode Zen
presets.note: Pay per use, plus free models with an account-wide quota.

presets.name: OpenRouter
presets.note: Pay per use across many providers.

presets.name: Custom or local
presets.note: Any OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint, such as Ollama (http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1) or LM Studio.

presets.name: On this device
presets.note: Gemma 4 E4B on the phone's GPU: offline, private, slower and less accurate than the cloud models.
